_comment: Segment design and names, assigned AFTER reviewing cluster profiles (spec 12.3/12.4). Cluster keys J0..J4 are K-Means clusters relabelled by descending mean Value_Score. 'expect' is a pandas query on the segment profile that must hold, so a re-run cannot attach a name to the wrong cluster.
selection_note: Joint K-Means k=5 chosen over the layered 3+3 design: higher silhouette (0.279 vs ~0.267), every segment >= 3% of customers (layered had a 1.9% segment), ARI >= 0.93 across 5 seeds. Age lowered silhouette at every k, so it is used for profiling only. Single vs repeat (spec layer 1) is kept as the evidence tag.

segments.customer_characteristics: Late twenties to early thirties, slightly more male, metro-heavy like the base
segments.transaction_characteristics: Two or more transactions in the window, mid-size tickets, seen recently
segments.financial_behaviour: Mid-to-high balances; the largest share of high-value customers outside the one-time groups
segments.potential_needs: Investment / MF, credit card, premium account
segments.action: Deepen the relationship: RM introduction call, needs review, bundle offer
segments.kpi: Products discussed per contact; repeat activity next 30 days

segments.customer_characteristics: Same age and city mix as the base
segments.transaction_characteristics: One mid-size transaction (around Rs 1,000) in the last two weeks of the window
segments.financial_behaviour: Mid balances, comparable to Engaged Repeat Users
segments.potential_needs: Debit / credit card usage, digital banking activation
segments.action: Convert to repeat use: welcome-back nudge and digital activation while the visit is recent

segments.customer_characteristics: Same age and city mix as the base
segments.transaction_characteristics: One mid-size transaction, last seen more than two weeks before the as-of date
segments.financial_behaviour: Mid balances; value comparable to recent spenders but not seen recently
segments.potential_needs: Re-engagement before the relationship goes quiet
segments.action: Win-back: service call or message to understand needs; offer relevant product review

segments.customer_characteristics: Slightly younger than the base, less metro-concentrated
segments.financial_behaviour: Lower balances; very small share of total value
segments.action: Low-cost digital nurture only; no RM time
segments.kpi: Digital engagement rate; cost per contact

segments.financial_behaviour: Balance close to zero (median under Rs 1,000)
segments.potential_needs: Account activation, minimum-balance or service check
segments.action: Service check and activation; exclude from cross-sell lists
segments.kpi: Share with balance above Rs 1,000 next quarter
